    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AnestheticDart
    Represents an Anesthetic Dart weapon.
    AnimationPlayer
    Handles frame-based sprite animation for player rendering.
    AssetLoader
    Utility class responsible for loading image assets from the application's resources.
    BattleCallback
    Callback interface that decouples BattleView from the concrete GameController singleton.
    BattleController
    Controls the turn-based battle logic between the player (P'Tae) and an enemy Dinosaur.
    BattleView
    Represents the graphical battle interface between the player and a dinosaur enemy.
    ButtonSell
    A custom JavaFX Button that represents a sell action for a given Item.
    ButtonShop
    A custom JavaFX Button representing a purchasable item in the shop.
    Buyable
    Represents an object that can be purchased in the game.
    CarnivoreDinosaur
    A carnivorous dinosaur that actively hunts the player when nearby, and roams randomly when the player is out of range.
    ChongsamVideoScene
    A cinematic cut-scene that plays the Chongsam introduction video (/welcomescene/chongsamintro.mp4) as part of the game's opening sequence.
    Chunk
    Represents a fixed-size square region of the game world.
    ComboManager
    Manages the combo counter and score multiplier for the gym rhythm mini-game.
    CommandBox
    The CommandBox represents the player command interface during a battle.
    CretaceousExplorationScene
    The main JavaFX scene for the Cretaceous forest exploration game mode.
    DialogueManager
    DialogueManager is a singleton class responsible for handling dialogue rendering, typewriter animation, and dialogue queuing inside the game.
    DinoBall
    Represents a DinoBall item used for capturing dinosaurs.
    Dinosaur
    Abstract base class representing a dinosaur entity in the forest game mode.
    Dinosaur.Rarity
    Defines the rarity tier of a dinosaur, which affects how frequently it spawns.
    DinosaurFactory
    Factory class for creating pre-configured Dinosaur instances.
    ElectricGun
    Represents an Electric Gun weapon.
    ExpPotion
    Represents an Experience Potion item.
    GameController
    GameController
    GameEffect
    Plays a temporary visual effect (GIF or image) at a random position on screen, avoiding the active note lane area.
    GameLogic
    GameLogic
    GameLoop
    The GameLoop class represents the main game update loop for the gym rhythm mini-game.
    GameScene
    The active gameplay scene for the gym rhythm mini-game.
    GameState
    GameState
    GameTimer
    The GameTimer class manages a countdown timer for the gym mini-game.
    GameUI
    Builds and manages all visual elements for the gym rhythm mini-game.
    HealPotion
    Represents a Healing Potion item.
    HerbivoreDinosaur
    A herbivorous dinosaur that wanders the forest passively.
    HitController
    Handles player key press events during the gym rhythm mini-game.
    InfoBox
    A styled JavaFX VBox that displays a character's name and HP bar inside the battle scene.
    InputHandler
    Utility class for registering keyboard input handlers on a JavaFX Scene.
    IntroScene
    The opening/splash screen of Jurassic Tae.
    InventoryPane
    InventoryPane represents the graphical user interface for displaying the player's inventory in the lobby scene.
    Item
    Abstract base class representing a generic item in the game.
    KeyboardController
    The KeyboardController class handles keyboard input for the lobby game mode.
    Main
    Main entry point for the Jurassic Tae JavaFX application.
    MainMenu
    The main menu scene for the gym rhythm mini-game.
    MegaDinosaur
    A large, powerful dinosaur that relentlessly pursues the player at all times.
    NewsReportScene
    A scripted news-broadcast cut-scene that tells the backstory of Jurassic Tae through two animated TV reporters.
    Note
    Represents a single falling note in the gym rhythm mini-game.
    NoteManager
    Manages the lifecycle of all active Notes in the gym rhythm mini-game.
    Player
    The Player class represents the controllable character in the lobby game mode.
    Potion
    Abstract base class representing a potion item in the game.
    Reporter
    Represents an animated TV reporter sprite used in NewsReportScene.
    RifleGun
    Represents a Rifle Gun weapon.
    ScoreManager
    Manages the player's score during a gym rhythm mini-game session.
    Sellable
    Represents an object that can be sold by the player in the game.
    SellScene
    A JavaFX StackPane that represents the sell/catalog screen in the shop UI.
    ShopScene
    ShopScene represents the shop interface in the lobby where players can purchase and sell items.
    SpawnCanvas
    The main game canvas for the lobby (spawn) area.
    SpawnScreen
    SpawnScreen represents the main lobby screen where the player spawns.
    SpeedPotion
    Represents a Speed Potion item.
    StrengthPotion
    Represents a Strength Potion item.
    TamedDinosaur
    Represents a tamed dinosaur that can be treated as a sellable item.
    Weapon
    Abstract base class representing a weapon item in the game.
    WorldItem
    Represents a collectible item spawned at a fixed position in the game world.
    WorldManager
    Manages the state of the forest game world, including chunk loading, dinosaur spawning, item pickup, collision detection, and battle triggering.
    WorldPoint
    An immutable value object representing a 2D integer grid coordinate.
    WorldRenderer
    Handles all rendering for the forest game world each frame.
